data.name: Nishaath
data.gender_notes: Nishaath is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'nish'at, which means 'gift' or 'grace'. In Islamic tradition, the name Nishaath is often given to signify the blessings and favors bestowed upon a child by Allah. The name Nishaath carries the meaning “Gift, Grace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nishaath usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine blessings and grace.
data.etymology: Nishaath belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nishaath total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: نِشآث
in_arabic.meaning: المَنافعُ لِلناسِ تَعَرَّضَ لِها وَكَفَتَها فُضلاً
in_arabic.long_meaning: يعني نِشآث المَنافعُ لِلناسِ، وَهِيَ مَنافعُ جَميعِيَّةٌ تُعَدُّ لِلناسِ فُضلاً. وَتَسمى هذِهِ المَنافعُ بِأَنَّها تَتعَرَّضُ لِلناسِ وَتُكَفِّلُهُمُ. وَالنِشآثُ مِنَ النِعَمِ الَّتي تَعَرَّضَت لِلناسِ وَأَعطَت لَهُمُ مِنَ الرِزقِ. وَالنِشآثُ يَكونُ عَملَ يَوميَّةٍ يَشملُ مِنَ المَنافعِ. وَيَكونُ تَعَرُّضاً لِلناسِ لِيُكَفِّلَهُمُ. وَهُوَ مِنَ الرِزقِ الَّذي يُعطى لِلناسِ مِنَ اللهِ. وَهُوَ مِنَ الفَضلِ الَّذي يُكَفِّلُهُ اللهُ لِلناسِ. وَالنِشآثُ يَكونُ حَبيبَ اللَهِ لِلناسِ. وَالنِشآثُ يَكونُ مَنِّ اللَهِ لِلناسِ.
